name: LanguageProvider
description: A React context provider that sets the active UI language ('es' | 'en') for all Traxion design system components it wraps. Default language is Spanish ('es'), so components work correctly without a provider. Exports LanguageProvider, LanguageProviderProps, DesignSystemLanguage, and the useDesignSystemLanguage hook.

props.name: language
props.description: The active language for all descendant design system components. Affects all internal UI strings (labels, placeholders, ARIA text, empty states, etc.).

props.name: children
props.description: The component tree to wrap. All design system components inside will read the language from this provider.

accessibility.role: Renders no DOM element — pure context provider.
accessibility.keyboard: No keyboard behavior of its own. Affects ARIA labels of descendant components.
accessibility.aria: No ARIA attributes. Component affects aria-label, aria-labelledby, and title strings of descendant components (e.g. DataTable pagination buttons, Dialog close button).
accessibility.notes: Wrapping the entire application ensures consistent language across all components. Per-subtree wrapping is valid for mixed-language layouts.

recommendations.description: Coloca el LanguageProvider cerca de la raíz de tu aplicación para que todos los componentes hereden el idioma consistentemente.
No uses el hook useDesignSystemLanguage fuera del árbol del LanguageProvider (o sin provider). Sin provider, el idioma por defecto es 'es', lo cual puede ser inesperado en apps en inglés.

sections.title: Components affected
sections.content:
The following components read the active language from LanguageProvider and adapt their internal UI strings accordingly:

- **DataTable** — column drag tooltip, view options, pagination controls, empty states, selection bar
- **DatePicker** / **DateRangePicker** / **DateTimePicker** / **DateTimeRangePicker** — placeholders, clear/apply buttons, time labels
- **Pagination** — navigation aria-labels, ellipsis label
- **Dialog** — close button aria-label
- **Sheet** — close button aria-label
- **Stepper** — step indicator aria-labels
- **AiInsight** — collapse/expand button aria-labels
- **FileDropZone** — drop zone aria-label and instruction text
- **SortableBoard** — empty column placeholder text

sections.title: useDesignSystemLanguage hook
DatePicker localeCode interaction
sections.content:
DatePicker components have a separate `localeCode` prop that controls date formatting via date-fns. When `localeCode` is not explicitly set, it defaults to the active `language` from the provider. You can always override it independently:

```tsx
// Uses 'en' formatting because localeCode is not set, inherits from provider
<LanguageProvider language="en">
  <DatePicker />
</LanguageProvider>

// Forces Spanish date format even inside an English LanguageProvider
<LanguageProvider language="en">
  <DatePicker localeCode="es" />
</LanguageProvider>
```
